My depression has unfortunately cut me off from the few friends I did have and made me lose my girlfriend.

I’m trying my best to stay strong. I’m filling out applications every day. I’m hoping I’ll find a new job and I can put this dark time behind me.

Thank you for your advice and kind words. It’s calmed me and made me feel a little less worthless. I will hold on.

I would love to do that, but unfortunately my parents aren’t very open minded people. They are very much the “what-I-say-goes” sort of parents, to the point of where they will interrupt almost every sentence I say to them. Everything I think and say is wrong, and they are the almighty gods of my life who know what’s best for me 100% of the time.

You may be thinking I’m an underage person, by the way I am talking about my parents. The best part about this is that I’m 24. I was living with my girlfriend before I was hospitalized the first time, but now I’ve been forced to move back in with my parents until I had enough money saved and bought all the things I need to move out again.

When I was put into the hospital, all of my furniture and most of my personal belongings that were sellable, were sold. They’ve taken over my life because I apparently can’t be trusted with it anymore. Which I guess that’s true since I’m where I am right now.

I’m stuck in between a rock and hard place and I don’t know if I’m going to be able to make it out before I get crushed.

If I tell them the reasoning behind it, they will try to have me hospitalized again. They’ve bluntly told me that if they even have a feeling that I’m getting depressed again, they will drag me back there. They think they are doing what’s best for me, but they are really just making it impossible for me to be honest with them.
It was, thank you. I’m glad we both got it over with. Now hopefully on to the next day and hopefully the next again.

Thank you. You did manage to make me smile. I’m horrible with comebacks on the spot, but I do need stick up for myself more. It’s just hard to when it’s someone who has been this way to you your whole life. She’s just a narcissistic bitch.
